TreeView.summary: Tree control, a Control subclass that owns and manages a TreeViewNode root, including initial tree parsing, node selection and height fitting.

props.classname: Class name string, "treeview", used to identify the control type.
props.autosize: Fixed to true: UpdateLayout resizes the control to the root node's height.
props.minItemHeight: Minimum height of each node row in pixels. Default 16, passed to the root node as minHeight.
props.defaultWidth: Default width used when width is not set explicitly. Default "100%".
props.defaultHeight: Default height used when height is not set explicitly. Default "100%".
props.selected: Index of the initially selected node. Default 1; applied via Select(sel) at construction, values <= 0 select nothing.
props.root: The root TreeViewNode, created by New with root=true and expanded=defaultExpanded.
props.nodes: Initial tree data table: entries are strings (node captions) or nested tables (child lists), parsed recursively by ParseInitTable at construction.
props.defaultExpanded: Whether new and root nodes start expanded. Default false, passed to every new node.
props.OnSelectNode: Event table fired when the selected node changes; callback receives (newSelected, oldSelected).

TreeView:New.desc: Creates the root node, parses nodes into the initial tree, AddChild's it, calls UpdateLayout, then selects the initial node by the selected index.

TreeView:GetNodeByCaption.desc: Forwards to root:GetNodeByCaption for a depth-first search of the first node with a matching caption.

TreeView:GetNodeByIndex.desc: Forwards to root:GetNodeByIndex(index, 0), a counting depth-first search for node number index.
TreeView:GetNodeByIndex.returns: the node object, or nil when not found

TreeView:Select.desc: Accepts a node object or an index, stores the selection as a weak link, invalidates both the old and new nodes, then fires the nodes' OnSelectChange(true/false) and TreeView.OnSelectNode(new, old).

TreeView:UpdateLayout.desc: Applies a (0, 0, clientWidth) constraint to the root node and Realigns it; with autosize it also resizes itself to the root height.

fileDesc: Defines TreeView, which creates the root node, parses the initial node table, manages node selection and fits its height to the tree contents.
